name: Training Dummy
art_prompt: a straw training dummy: a burlap sack body stuffed with straw tied with rope at the neck and waist, a round burlap sack head with a red and white painted bullseye target on its face and no eyes, two stubby straw-stuffed arms sticking out sideways, straw poking out at the seams, standing on a single thick wooden post planted in a small wooden cross stand
back_hint: seen from behind: the plain burlap back of the sack head and body, the rope ties, the post and the cross stand, no target
dead_hint: knocked over and lying broken on its side, its post snapped, straw spilling out, lying sideways across the picture with its target head on the left
motion: standing still on its post, wobbling very slightly
doc: The debug arena's punching bag: it stands where it is put, takes every hit like a creature and never hits back.
